paragraphs: Fermi Inc's stock price is 2.46, with a change of -0.81% from the prior close and -18.54% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of November 18, 2026.

Recent news includes reports of delays to Project Matador's AP1000 reactors and a trimmed fair value estimate. Amazon was named as Fermi's 600 MW customer for Project Matador, with a $200 million prepayment.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 and a Form 144, as well as a 10-Q filing that discloses financial and operational updates. An insider transaction report was filed on November 16, 2026, and a notice of proposed sale was filed on November 12, 2026.
